name: The Tom and Jerry Show
description: The iconic cat and mouse rivals are back in a fresh take on the classic series. Preserving the look, characters and sensibility of the original, this series shines a brightly colored, high-definition lens on the madcap slapstick and never-ending battle that has made Tom and Jerry two of the most beloved characters of all time.

videos.title: Spike Gets Skooled
videos.overview: Tom gets Spike sent to obedience school, and Jerry is left without a protector. When Spike returns, Tom tries hard to get Spike to revert to his old ways. Jerry fights back to make sure that Spike keeps his cool.

videos.title: Cat's Ruffled Fur-niture
videos.overview: Tom is under strict orders to not wake the Witch sisters, but Jerry is set on getting Tom in trouble. When Tom uses the magic spell wand and makes all of the furniture come alive, he must get the help of Newt to make everything go back as it was.

videos.title: Sleep Disorder
videos.overview: Rick buys Ginger a brand new mattress with a lot of high tech features. Tom is under strict orders to never sleep on it, but Butch convinces him to try it out. Jerry uses the controls against them and soon that mattress is out of control and destroys the entire house.

videos.title: Tom's In-Tents Adventure
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry get a taste of the great outdoors on their camping trip to Yosemite. Tom tries hard to relax, but nature - and all its inhabitants, including bears - get in his way.

videos.title: Birthday Bashed
videos.overview: When Tom and Jerry accidentally ruin Spike's birthday party for Tyke, he forces them to take over. They must entertain and take care of the puppy birthday bash, but no matter what they do, nothing seems to ever work out right.

videos.title: Feline Fatale
videos.overview: When Toodles hires Tom and Jerry to investigate and protect her against a threat to her Tuna can inheritance. They go investigate, and a mysterious figure keeps trying to hurt them. They discover Butch was also hired by Toodles to protect the tuna. Spike was guarding the cans, but was distracted by the fighting and leaves the cans unprotected. They discover Toodles wasn't being completely honest with her story.

videos.title: Cat Nippy
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry accidentally get locked out in the snow. They chase each other in the winter wonderland, until they realize they can't get back in. They work together to get back indoors as the weather turns ugly.

videos.title: Ghosts of a Chance
videos.overview: Jerry causes Tom to lose 8 out of his 9 lives. Tom uses magic to bring them back, and instead is stuck with 8 annoying ghost versions of himself. They try to catch Jerry, who is still too clever for them. Tom decides to work with Jerry and they come up with a magic spell to send these ghosts back where they came.

videos.title: Holed-Up
videos.overview: When Jerry ventures out of his hole for a late night snack, Tom has a trap set for him. Unfortunately for Tom, he falls into his own trap and gets his head stuck through the wall.

videos.title: One of a Kind
videos.overview: Detectives Tom and Jerry are hired by Polly the Dog to get back her collar from mean Barkley at the park. Later, Barkley reforms when he meets Polly and falls in love with her.

videos.title: Belly Achin'
videos.overview: Little Quacker enlists Jerry's help to fix his favorite birdbath that has cracked, but the two get sidetracked by the scent of Tom's delicious Chinese takeout.

videos.title: Dog Daze
videos.overview: When Tom and Jerry fail to do things the right way, Spike must do everything he can to keep from losing his temper in front of Tyke.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Ginger is in charge of taking care of her mother's bird and Tom tries his hardest to keep from eating the bird.

videos.title: Vampire Mouse
videos.overview: Jerry pretends to be a vampire to scare Tom. Now it's up to Tom - with the help of his friend Newt - to defeat the vampire mouse!

videos.title: Entering and Breaking
videos.overview: When Rick leaves Spike in charge of protecting the house against burglars, Spike steps up and trains Tom and Jerry to be his helpers.

videos.title: Franken Kitty
videos.overview: Tom is mistaken for Dr. Bigby's cat Wilson. Now Tom must convince Dr. Bigby he has the wrong cat! Meanwhile, Jerry and Napoleon are left with the real, very vicious Wilson.

videos.title: Tom-Foolery
videos.overview: Butch tricks Tom into switching places with him and sends Tom off to live the life of a street cat. But each finds the others life to be quite difficult.

videos.title: Haunted Mouse
videos.overview: Tuffy hires detectives Tom and Jerry to investigate the ghost hauntings in his house.

videos.title: Here's Looking A-Choo Kid
videos.overview: When it seems like Spike has developed an allergic reaction to Tom, Rick buys Ginger a hypoallergetic cat named Glory. Could Glory be too good to be true?

videos.title: Superfied
videos.overview: Dr. Bigby creates cookies that can give animals superpowers. Jerry and Napoleon sneak some cookies and have fun terrorizing Tom… until the tables are turned.

videos.title: What a Pain!
videos.overview: After a particularly destructive chase, Tom and Spike have to go to the vet and Ginger hires an exterminator to take care of Jerry and Tuffy once and for all.

videos.title: Hop to It
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry have to go retrieve an ingredient for the witches' spell before sundown, but when Tom sees Princess Toodles, he quickly forgets the mission.

videos.title: For the Love of Ruggles
videos.overview: Tom kicks Spike's beloved chew toy Ruggles over the fence and has to get it back when he sees how heartbroken Spike becomes.

videos.title: Sleuth or Consequences
videos.overview: Butch and a squirrel detective steal all of Tom and Jerry's customers by using high-tech devices to solve crimes. Tom and Jerry challenges them to a case-solving competition.

videos.title: Dinner Is Swerved
videos.overview: When Rick and Ginger leave Tom home alone, Tom and Jerry decide to invite their lady friends over for a romantic dinner. But things don't go as planned.

videos.title: Bottled Up Emotions
videos.overview: Jerry gets affected by one of Dr. Bigby's experiments.

videos.title: Turn About
videos.overview: Butch locks Tom in the basement to keep him from a date with Toodles. Tom tries to escape, but keeps getting blocked by Jerry and Tuffy who think it's a monster downstairs.

videos.title: The Plight Before Christmas
videos.overview: Tom accidentally puts a spell on Santa and, as a result of Santa's new state, Tom and Jerry volunteer to help Santa deliver gifts. A Christmas miracle occurs.

videos.title: Tuffy Love
videos.overview: Jerry and Tuffy are getting ready to go to a family reunion, but unfortunately, Tuffy gets left behind. Tom thinks Tuffy is easy pickings, but he's in for a surprise.

videos.title: Poof!
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry are hired by a bad magician to find out where his pigeon disappeared to during a magic trick gone awry.

videos.title: Top Cat
videos.overview: When Tom and Butch compete to be top cat in the United Mouse Catchers, they must prove their worth by finally catching Jerry.

videos.title: Mummy Dearest
videos.overview: Hildie and Beatie commemorate the passing of their mother and Tom tries to help out by bringing her back from the grave.

videos.title: Domestic Kingdom
videos.overview: Tom stars in a documentary that mis-characterizes his daily activities. All of his daily activities, from chasing Jerry to "romancing" Toodles are recorded.

videos.title: Molecular Break Up
videos.overview: Dr. Bigby invents a transporting machine that accidentally transports Jerry and Tom to Paris where they meet Gigi and Cozette.

videos.title: Just Plane Nuts
videos.overview: Rick and Ginger go on a vacation and bring Tom and Spike aboard the plane. Stowaways Jerry and Tuffy are also on board, and soon the pets are chasing each other on the plane!

videos.title: Pets Not Welcome
videos.overview: When Rick and Ginger sneak Tom and Spike into a hotel where pets are not allowed, they make the pets promise not to leave the hotel room. Will the pets behave?

videos.title: Cruisin' for a Bruisin
videos.overview: On a cruise ship with Rick and Ginger, Jerry and Tuffy leave Spike and Tom in the room to go explore, but a vicious ship cat named Meathead will stop at nothing to terrorize them.

videos.title: Road Trippin'
videos.overview: Rick and Ginger take Tom and Spike on a road trip where Spike is terrorized by a dog traveling in a trailer. Jerry and Tuffy get caught in Rick and Ginger's suitcase.

videos.title: Magic Mirror
videos.overview: Hildie and Beatie bring home a fortune-telling magic mirror. When it shows Tom a future he doesn't like, he tries everything to avoid it - but this seems to make things worse.

videos.title: Bone Dry
videos.overview: Spike comes to Tom and Jerry for help finding his missing bones and the detectives investigate a community garden.

videos.title: My Bot-y Guard
videos.overview: Dr. Bigby upgrades Bot to a Bot-y Guard. When Tom sets off Bot's defensive systems, things get out of control and Jerry and Napoleon must disarm Bot without hurting him.

videos.title: Little Quacker and Mister Fuzzy Hide
videos.overview: When the witches' herb garden is destroyed, Tom sets a trap to capture the pest responsible. Quackers helps him but is unknowingly the pest Tom seeks to capture.

videos.title: Pipeline
videos.overview: When Tom and Jerry lose Ginger's wedding ring down the drain, they send Jerry through the pipes to retrieve it, but it leads down the drain, to the sewers and out to the beach!

videos.title: No Brain, No Gain
videos.overview: Dr. Bigby creates a helmet that turns Tom into a genius. Napoleon, Jerry and Hamster work together to take down the newly smart Tom who is now building a mouse-destroying weapon.

videos.title: Cat Napped
videos.overview: Tom witnesses what seems like the kidnapping of Misty, the cute cat across the street. He enlists the help of her neighbor to track down her whereabouts.

videos.title: Black Cat
videos.overview: Fed up with Tom, Hildie and Beatie threaten to get a "real" witch's cat: a black cat. In desperation, Tom takes a magic potion that makes him turn black but only temporarily.

videos.title: Hunger Strikes

videos.title: Gravi-Tom
videos.overview: Jerry and Napoleon play around with Bigby's brand-new anti- gravity machine... until Tom breaks into the lab and a chase begins.

videos.title: Ghost Party

videos.title: Cat-Astrophe
videos.overview: Tom accidentally gives himself electrical superpowers, and now Jerry must fend off Tom while fighting off an asteroid heading right toward Bigby's lab.

videos.title: Curse Case Scenario

Harry craves a respite from his life as a nomad on the party cruise ship circuit, but it doesn't take him long to realize that life on the high seas has its advantages (specifically not being holed-up with Tom).

videos.title: Charm School Dropouts
videos.overview: After an unsuccessful attempt by Butch and Tom to charm Toodles, she sends them to a Charm School.

videos.title: Driven Crazy
videos.overview: When Tom is ordered to wash the car for the Duke and Duchess, he takes it for a spin with Jerry and Tuffy along for the ride.

videos.title: A Star Forlorn
videos.overview: Tom is chosen to be a spokescat for Cat Snacks.

videos.title: Bird Flue
videos.overview: Tom is ordered to sweep the chimney and puts up with two birds and Jerry.

videos.title: Tom's Tangled Web
videos.overview: A bite from a spider transforms Tom into a spider.

videos.title: Saddle Soreheads
videos.overview: When a show champion horse goes missing, Tom is on the lookout for it as Jerry tries to hide the horse.

videos.title: Rosemary's Gravy
videos.overview: Ginger's mother, Rosemary comes to care for an injured Rick. When she throws away the unhealthy food, Rick, Tom, Jerry and Spike look for unhealthy food since they can't stand her cooking style.

videos.title: Eggs on a Train
videos.overview: Detectives Tom and Jerry are hired by a dog to escort his precious egg, but Butch and Meathead try to steal it.

videos.title: Truffle Trouble
videos.overview: Tom is assigned to bring Truffles for a pig down at a farm.

videos.title: Bars and Stripes
videos.overview: Tom is wrongfully accused of robbing a jewelry store and he ends up at the Animal Shelter. Jerry helps out by clearing his name.

videos.title: Cuckoo Clock
videos.overview: Ginger warns Tom not to break her family heirloom cuckoo clock, and he does it by accident. He attempts to fix it before Ginger comes back from a game of golf.

videos.title: Plant Food
videos.overview: Tom goes to a castle that has a greenhouse that has man-eating plants.

videos.title: Whack a Gopher
videos.overview: Tom must get rid of the gopher that's been eating the garden food.

videos.title: Hula Whoops
videos.overview: Detectives Tom and Jerry travel with Toodles to Hawaii for a case.

videos.title: A Game of Bones
videos.overview: When Spike thinks a black bone that Tom has found is cursed, Spike becomes nice to Tom.

videos.title: Bull Fight
videos.overview: Detectives Tom and Jerry try to stop a 40 year old turtle from fighting against a bull in the boxing ring.

videos.title: No Contest
videos.overview: When Spike enters Tyke in the Puppy Olympics, he gets Tom to help train Tyke.

videos.title: Calorie Count
videos.overview: Jerry's uncle Count DeCalorie visits and shows that he's not overweight anymore, but all the delicious food he eats puts the weight back on him.

videos.title: Fortune Hunters
videos.overview: Detectives Tom and Jerry are on the case to bring back a smelly dog's fortune.

videos.title: Game Changer
videos.overview: Tom walks into a castle to discover a checkerboard game has come to life.

videos.title: Kiss and Makeup
videos.overview: New neighbor Misty Makeup Mavin is selling beauty makeup and wants a kiss from Tom. Jerry and Tuffy attempt to stop the kiss from happening.

videos.title: Suitable for Framing
videos.overview: Life really does imitate art for Tom when a ghost artist paints a nice picture of him and the picture seems to change whenever Tom has a different thing happen to him.

videos.title: Springtime for Spike
videos.overview: Spike falls in love with a french poodle named Sabrina who takes more of a liking to Tom than him.

videos.title: Knighty Knight Knight
videos.overview: Tom, Jerry and Tuffy discover that a knight suit has 3 kittens inside of it.

videos.title: Phan-Tom of the Oompah
videos.overview: It's up to Jerry Von Mousing to stop Tom as "The Phantom Of The Oompah."

videos.title: Ballad of the Catnip Kid
videos.overview: Tom dreams that he is The Catnip Kid up against Sheriff Jerry.

videos.title: Mirror Image
videos.overview: When the mirrors break in the castle, Tom, Jerry and Tuffy are cursed with bad luck when they stumble upon a mirror that has mischievous versions of Tom in it.

videos.title: Faux Hunt
videos.overview: Tom gets confused for a fox by a local-fox-hunting party.

videos.title: Gym Rat
videos.overview: Overweight Jerry starts working out on a weight machine supplied to him by cousin Muscles. Not to be oudone, Tom starts lifting weights as well, which sets up an epic battle royale between the cat and mouse.

videos.title: Scrunch Time
videos.overview: Tom's obsession with the sound his new crinkle ball drives the rest of the household crazy, forcing them to take drastic measures to rid the house of the annoying toy.

videos.title: Mice From Mars
videos.overview: Mice visitors from Mars force Tom to change the way he treats Jerry.

videos.title: The Maltese Pigeon
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry are hired to find a missing priceless Maltese Pigeon.

videos.title: Loch Ness Mess
videos.overview: Tom enlists the help of the lake monster to terrorize the mouse village forcing Jerry Van Mouseling to intervene and save the day.

videos.title: Werewolf of Catsylvania
videos.overview: A werewolf terrorizes Tom and the inhabitants of the Catsylvania village.

videos.title: The Great Catsby
videos.overview: Tom must compete with his American cousin for the right to remain a Butler at Postlewaite manor.

videos.title: A Class Of Their Own
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry are forced to go back to Detective School in order to renew their detective licenses.

videos.title: Yeti, Set, Go
videos.overview: When Tom inadvertently set a Yeti loose on the town, Jerry Van Mouseling must subdue the beast.

videos.title: Ghoul's Gold
videos.overview: Tom serves an evil pirate determined to steal treasure belonging to the village mice until Jerry Van Mouseling foils his plans.

videos.title: What About Blob?
videos.overview: Tom turns into a Blob monster and proceeds to eat everything in sight, including the village mice! Jerry Van Mouseling to the rescue!

videos.title: Mouse Party
videos.overview: Rick and Ginger leave town with instructions for Tom to keep the house in order, but Jerry's got other ideas.

videos.title: Maust
videos.overview: Tom is tricked into helping an evil magician capture all of the mice in the village, but Jerry Van Mouseling foils the magician's plans.

videos.title: Tom Prix
videos.overview: Tom, forced into driving a race car created by evil Dr. Otto, terrorizes the village mice until Jerry Van Mouseling comes to their rescue.

videos.title: Hip Replacement
videos.overview: The neighbor's cat turns out to be a hipster who's laid back attitudes and behaviors are soon adopted by Tom and the other alley cats. Annoyed, Jerry decides to put an end to all of their silly nonsense.

videos.title: Cat-A-Combs
videos.overview: Tom falls into a manhole and finds a magic cloak that turns him into King of the Catacombs.

videos.title: Cat-astrophic Failure
videos.overview: Spike leaves Tom in charge of his boy Tyke only to discover upon his return that Tyke now behaves more like a cat than a dog.

videos.title: Un-Welcome Home
videos.overview: After taking the heat again from Ginger for Jerry's shenanigans, fed up Tom decides to pack his bags and go home to his birth family. But can you ever really go home again?

videos.title: Downton Crabby
videos.overview: Jerry battles Tom to save a crab from becoming the Duke and Duchess' main course.

videos.title: Mega-Tom
videos.overview: Frankenstein turns Tom into a colossus and Tom ends up terrorizing the village mice until Jerry Van Mouseling saves the day.

videos.title: Jabberwock
videos.overview: Tom finds himself trapped inside a Catsylvania bedtime story and fleeing from a furious Jabberwock.

videos.title: A Clown Without Pity
videos.overview: An evil ringmaster recruits Tom to help him snare the Catsylvania mice.

videos.title: Duck Sitting
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry must keep Lil' Quacker safe from Butch and Meathead so that he can testify to a crime in court.

videos.title: Three Heads Are Better Than One
videos.overview: Tom, Jerry Van Mouseling and the village mice must deal with a howling three head dog that Tom has accidentally awakened.

videos.title: Dam Busters
videos.overview: Tom must cut fire word for the Manor fireplaces while Jerry harasses him.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: A guilty conscience causes Butch to change his ways. But Tom, Jerry, Spike and Tuffy quickly decide they like the old Butch better.

videos.title: Counting Sheep
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry are hired by Dixie Wolf to find all the sheep that have gone missing.

videos.title: The Old Gray Hair
videos.overview: After discovering a gray hair, Spikes decides he's too old to be the alpha of the house which sends Tom into full bully mode. Jerry will have to act fast to convince Spike he's still the alpha dog.

videos.title: Chutes and Tatters
videos.overview: Tom's assigned laundry duty at the estate and Jerry's determined to soil the job.

videos.title: (Not) Your Father's Mouse-Stache
videos.overview: It's the battle of the moustaches when Tom accidentally drinks a hair tonic potion left behind by Jerry and Butch realizes he needs to acquire some facial hair of his own if he is to compete for Toodles and Dollface's attentions.

videos.title: Balloonatics
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry fight each other with the balloons that Rick has placed all over the house to surprise Ginger on their anniversary.

videos.title: Ball of Fame
videos.overview: When Tom and Jerry's antics unearth an autographed baseball, he warns Tom to keep his paws off it! Tom attempts to obey, but Jerry's got other ideas. The guys chase the treasured ball all over the neighborhood.

videos.title: My Buddy Guard
videos.overview: A robot turns from friend to foe forcing Tom, Jerry, Spike and Tuffy to team up in order to rid themselves of the invader.

videos.title: Hangin' Tough
videos.overview: Tom battles Butch to prove to Toodles that he's the better gentlemen. While they battle it out, Jerry calls in Cousin Muscles who demonstrate how a true gentleman really behaves.

videos.title: Shadow of a Doubt
videos.overview: The detectives are desperately trying to help George and Junior find a missing black panther from the city zoo.

videos.title: It's the Little Things
videos.overview: When Tom drinks a potion given to him by a Gypsy woman and shrinks to the size of an insect, he must beg Jerry Van Mouseling for help in finding a cure.

videos.title: Always Say Never Again
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry are hired by a British super spy to help guard the Queen's precious objects while they are on display in the city.

videos.title: Into the Woods
videos.overview: When an accident leaves Jerry wrapped head to toe in bandages and unable to take his scout troop camping, a guilt-ridden Tom decides to lead the kids into the woods himself.

videos.title: Mice Fair Ladies
videos.overview: Jerry's cousins pay a return visit to the Manor eager to create mayhem for Tom, things get crazier than ever when the cousins wives show up as well.

videos.title: Hot Wings
videos.overview: A lemur belonging to the Duchess' adventurous cousin puts Tom's job as Under-Butler in jeopardy.

videos.title: Wild Goose Chase
videos.overview: The detectives agree to escort a goofy Canadian goose back across the border before duck hunting season begins.

videos.title: Play Date with Destiny
videos.overview: A wild chase leads Jerry into the arms of a little girl and now Tom has to help Jerry escape her clutches.

videos.title: Mind Your Royal Manners
videos.overview: Fearful that he will lose his place in the Manor, Tom adopts the attitude of a member of the Royal Guard in order to keep the mice and their new friend, Boswell, from wreaking havoc in the kitchen.

videos.title: A Rare Breed
videos.overview: Jerry is mistaken for a rare breed of Guinea Pig by the Duchess' professor friend and uses his protected, elevated status to create endless problems for Tom.

videos.title: Oh, Brother
videos.overview: Spike's big brother, Max, shows up on the run from some bad guys and Spike must enlist the help of Tuffy, Tom and Jerry to get rid of him.

videos.title: Who Sled the Dogs Out?
videos.overview: The detectives help a team of Huskies find the villain who is determined to sabotage their dog sled race.

videos.title: Tick, Tick, Tick
videos.overview: Jerry uses a friendly tick to get even with Tom.

videos.title: The Butterfly Effect
videos.overview: Tuffy and Jerry, pretending to be butterflies, prank Tom and cause all sorts of trouble in the house until the Duke catches Tuffy with the intention of adding him to his butterfly collection.

videos.title: Curiosity Thrilled The Cat
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry become obsessed with the contents of a wrapped package and go to extraordinary measure to find out what's inside without being caught by Rick and Ginger.

videos.title: The Wearing of the Green
videos.overview: Jerry helps a Leprechaun retrieve the pot of gold that he's lost to Tom.

videos.title: Ball of Fire
videos.overview: The hot dog relish that Crooked Eddie brings to the detectives turns out to be an explosive device that Tom and Jerry must now return to the lab before it inadvertently blows up the entire city.

videos.title: The Masked Mouse
videos.overview: Tuffy surprises Jerry with a visit from the actor who plays his favorite TV show character, "The Masked Mouse". Turns out, the actor is a prima donna who makes everyone's life miserable.

videos.title: Flower Power
videos.overview: A bouquet of flowers causes Tom no end of trouble.

videos.title: Polar Excess
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry have to contend with a baby polar bear that has been mistakenly delivered to Rick and Ginger's house.

videos.title: Un-Easy Chair
videos.overview: Tom must enlist the neighborhood cats to help him remove the cat hairs from Rick's new massage chair.

videos.title: Something to Crow About
videos.overview: A scarecrow terrorizes Catsylvania.

videos.title: Hush Puppy
videos.overview: Ginger is asked by her mother to watch her dog, Goliath, while she is away. Goliath is a gentle giant, unless you wake him from his nap!

videos.title: Dog Star Spike
videos.overview: The Mice from Mars make a return visit and set about making mischief between Spike and Tom.

videos.title: Donut Daze
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry get locked inside a travel trunk and end up on a vacation cruise to France.

videos.title: Tom's Cruise
videos.overview: Tom uses a new fangled scientific machine to make copies off himself creating a living nightmare for Jerry.

videos.title: Ten Toms the Trouble
videos.overview: Tom is placed in charge of the preparations for the Duchess' surprise birthday party for nephew Rupert and Jerry is determined to make a mess of it all.

videos.title: Turkey Tom
videos.overview: Tom and Jerry work together to save a live turkey from becoming the centerpiece of a holiday feast.

videos.title: Tom Save the Queen
videos.overview: The detectives across the hall are responsible for a series of high profile thefts and are framing innocent people for the crimes.

videos.title: Party Animals
videos.overview: It's a battle royale over the last box of donuts.

videos.title: Tap Cat
videos.overview: An old pair of Ginger's tap shoes turns Tom into a tap dancing fanatic.

videos.title: The Ol' Switcheroo
videos.overview: Tuffy's wish to be as strong as Spike comes true.

videos.title: How to Be a Dog
videos.overview: Spike demonstrates for Tuffy what it takes to be a dog.

videos.title: See Ya Gator
videos.overview: Jerry befriends a lost baby gator, keeping it safe from harm until it's momma arrives to take it back home.

videos.title: All That Glitters
videos.overview: The cat and mouse detectives pose as bellhops at a swanky hotel to catch a jewel thief.

videos.title: Junkyard Pup
videos.overview: When Tyke is accidentally carried off to the local dump, Spike is forced to enlist the help of Jerry and Tom to get his boy back before Ace and Rocco, the junkyards guard dogs, turn him into a formidable junkyard pup.

videos.title: The French Mistake
videos.overview: Tom is placed in charge of caring for the Duchess' French Poodle and needs Tuffy and Jerry's help in keeping the ill-tempered mutt under control.

videos.title: A Kick in the Tail
videos.overview: When Tuffy shows an interest in soccer, Jerry decides to be the little guys coach and show him how the game is really played by beating Tom in a one-on-one match.

videos.title: Broom for Improvement
videos.overview: The gang do battle with a magical broom.

videos.title: Puppy Guard
videos.overview: An over protected Spike goes to extreme lengths to keep his precious pup safe from harm.

videos.title: Bones of Contention
videos.overview: Spikes bones are missing and Frankie the Rat is the culprit. Now all they have to do is catch in the dirty rat in the act.

videos.title: Farmed and Dangerous
videos.overview: Things get crazy down on the farm when a cat and mouse pursuit leads Jerry to hide his turtle egg in a hen's nest.

videos.title: Slam Dunk
videos.overview: The Cat and Mouse are hired to find out who absconded with Hoops McJumpalot's lucky high top sneakers.

videos.title: Attachment Disorder
videos.overview: Tom and Spike get glued together.
